keywords: Luxury Minimalist Edge Navigation Web UI

criteria: 1. Format: Website Hero Section UI, Desktop Web Concept, Dribbble/Behance Showcase Shot (widescreen/desktop aspect ratio, high-res)
2. Visual Hook: Full-bleed background or isolated 3D object, depth of field or surreal photo manipulation
3. UI Components: Floating Cards with Glassmorphism or Pill-shaped / Inverted rounded corners / Cutout tabs
4. Out-of-bounds / 3D Pop-out: Main subject overlapping dividers, clouds, or typography for 3D depth
5. Typography: Oversized Headline with high contrast & Text masking behind the subject
6. Navigation: Minimalist edge navigation (top horizontal menu bar, social icons, vertical slide numbers)

scroll: Sticky / Pinned Elements (center subject pinned while 001/002/003 specs scroll on sides)
Horizontal Scroll (Featured Motion Projects vertical-to-horizontal track)
Scroll Scrubbing (scroll percentage rotates/tilts/scales 3D showcase proportionally)
hoverAndCursor: Magnetic Buttons (Explore & circular arrow buttons pull toward cursor)
3D Card Tilt / Perspective Hover (Glassmorphism cards tilt with specular border shine)
Image Zoom & Mask Reveal (smooth zoom inside super-rounded/pill masks)
Liquid / Ripple Distortion (interactive SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap wave filter on hover)
Custom / Follower Cursor (glowing ring + dot with mix-blend-mode: difference over oversized text)
textAndTransitions: Split-Text / Staggered Reveal (character/word staggered entrance on oversized headlines)
Number Counter (120+, 10K+, 1000+ animated count-up on viewport entry)
Seamless Page Transition (clicking a corner/destination card expands smoothly to full-screen detail view without reload)
Marquee / Infinite Text Loop (continuous background kinetic typography loop)
ambientMotion: Floating Animation (zero-gravity sinusoidal bobbing on 3D subject, clouds, planets & badges)
Particle / Smoke System (HTML5 canvas drifting smoke & cosmic dust particles behind subject)
